# Sovrium design options

## `design`

| Option | Kind | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sovrium docs config design` | object | The app's design system in one key: the colour palette, ramps and roles; the type, space, shape, elevation, motion and layout foundations; density, baseline and per-engine-type component styling; the zone map; and the charter — logo, imagery, principles and voice. |
| `sovrium docs config design.colorScheme` | enum | Default color scheme before content renders: 'light', 'dark', or 'system' (follow prefers-color-scheme). Omitted, every app follows the visitor's system scheme, using the default dark palette when it declares no `darkColors`; declare 'light' to keep an app light. A visitor's stored theme-toggle choice still wins. |
| `sovrium docs config design.colors` | object | The app's named colour literals. Distinct from `design.ramps` (ordered ladders) and `design.colorRoles` (what a role resolves to). |
| `sovrium docs config design.darkColors` | object | Dark-scheme overrides for `design.colors`, keyed identically. Declared with no `colorScheme`, the app follows the visitor's system scheme. |
| `sovrium docs config design.ramps` | object | The app's colour ramps: ordered lightness ladders whose steps roles refer to by name. Distinct from `theme.colors`, which is an unordered palette of author tokens. |
| `sovrium docs config design.colorRoles` | object | Per-token usage guidance keyed by colour name. Answers the question `theme.colors` cannot: what is this colour FOR? Every key must name a token declared in the app's palette. |
| `sovrium docs config design.typeScale` | object | The app's type foundation: `families` (the faces) and `steps` (the ordered ladder). |
| `sovrium docs config design.typeScale.families` | object | Typography design tokens for font families and styles |
| `sovrium docs config design.typeScale.steps` | object | The app's ordered type ladder. Each declared step emits CSS custom properties (`--text-{step}` and its `--line-height` / `--font-weight` / `--letter-spacing` modifiers). |
| `sovrium docs config design.typeScale.steps.display` | object | One named step of the type scale: its size, and optionally its leading, weight, tracking and face |
| `sovrium docs config design.typeScale.steps.display.size` | string | Rendered size of this step, in `px` or `rem` |
| `sovrium docs config design.typeScale.steps.display.lineHeight` | number | Leading as a unitless ratio of the font size |
| `sovrium docs config design.typeScale.steps.display.weight` | enum | Weight of this step (100–900) |
| `sovrium docs config design.typeScale.steps.display.letterSpacing` | string | Tracking for this step |
| `sovrium docs config design.typeScale.steps.display.font` | string | Name of a face declared in `design.typeScale.families` |

| `sovrium docs config design.spacing` | object | The app's spacing ladder. Each step's name becomes the suffix of every spacing utility — padding, margin, gap and the rest. A display keyword (`block`, `inline`, `flex`, `grid`, `table`, `hidden`, `contents`) or a size keyword (`full`, `screen`, `auto`, `min`, `max`, `fit`, `svh`, `dvh`, `lvh`, `svw`, `dvw`, `lvw`, `none`, `lh`) is refused as a step name; `px` is allowed. |
| `sovrium docs config design.radius` | object | The app's corner radii, by name. Each name becomes the suffix of every rounding utility. |
| `sovrium docs config design.elevation` | object | The app's shadow levels, from flat to furthest off the page. Each name becomes the suffix of a shadow utility. |
| `sovrium docs config design.motion` | object | The app's motion foundation: the duration ladder, the easing set, the named keyframe blocks, and the animations composed out of them. |
| `sovrium docs config design.motion.durations` | object | The named lengths animations are allowed to take, from the quickest to the slowest. |
| `sovrium docs config design.motion.easings` | object | The named acceleration curves animations are allowed to use. |
| `sovrium docs config design.motion.keyframes` | object | Reusable sets of animation steps, each named, that the animations below refer to by name. |
| `sovrium docs config design.motion.animations` | object | The animations the app can play, each named and each spending one duration and one easing curve. |
| `sovrium docs config design.breakpoints` | object | The screen widths at which the layout changes, in pixels. Each name becomes a responsive prefix such as `md:`. |
| `sovrium docs config design.density` | object | The app's density ladder: three named steps declaring row padding, field height, small-button height, affordance gap and dense text size, optionally assigned per zone. Each step emits `--sv-density-row-y` / `-control-h` / `-button-h` / `-gap` / `-text`, which is what replaces the ten hard-coded `py-[5px]` / `text-[11px]` / `px-[7px]` literals in the recipes. |
| `sovrium docs config design.density.steps` | object | The three named density steps, tightest first |
| `sovrium docs config design.density.steps.compact` | object | One step of the density ladder: row padding, field height, small-button height, affordance gap and dense text size |
| `sovrium docs config design.density.steps.compact.rowY` | string | Vertical padding inside a row or list item |
| `sovrium docs config design.density.steps.compact.controlH` | string | Height of a text-entry control |
| `sovrium docs config design.density.steps.compact.buttonH` | string | Height of a small button |
| `sovrium docs config design.density.steps.compact.gap` | string | Horizontal gap between adjacent affordances |
| `sovrium docs config design.density.steps.compact.text` | string | Font size of dense secondary text |
| `sovrium docs config design.density.steps.cozy` | object | One step of the density ladder: row padding, field height, small-button height, affordance gap and dense text size |
| `sovrium docs config design.density.steps.cozy.rowY` | string | Vertical padding inside a row or list item |
| `sovrium docs config design.density.steps.cozy.controlH` | string | Height of a text-entry control |
| `sovrium docs config design.density.steps.cozy.buttonH` | string | Height of a small button |
| `sovrium docs config design.density.steps.cozy.gap` | string | Horizontal gap between adjacent affordances |
| `sovrium docs config design.density.steps.cozy.text` | string | Font size of dense secondary text |
| `sovrium docs config design.density.steps.roomy` | object | One step of the density ladder: row padding, field height, small-button height, affordance gap and dense text size |
| `sovrium docs config design.density.steps.roomy.rowY` | string | Vertical padding inside a row or list item |
| `sovrium docs config design.density.steps.roomy.controlH` | string | Height of a text-entry control |
| `sovrium docs config design.density.steps.roomy.buttonH` | string | Height of a small button |
| `sovrium docs config design.density.steps.roomy.gap` | string | Horizontal gap between adjacent affordances |
| `sovrium docs config design.density.steps.roomy.text` | string | Font size of dense secondary text |
| `sovrium docs config design.density.default` | enum | The density step every page runs at when its zone assigns none: 'compact', 'cozy' or 'roomy'. Omitted, pages run at 'compact' — the spacing Sovrium has always rendered. |
| `sovrium docs config design.density.byZone` | object | Which density step each declared zone runs at, overriding `default` for the pages that zone governs |
| `sovrium docs config design.density.floors` | object | The accessibility floors a density step may never cross. Both values are fixed; the field exists so the guarantee is visible in the config document, not so it can be tuned. |
| `sovrium docs config design.density.floors.controlH` | enum | Minimum inline-control height in px. Fixed at 24 — declaring it restates the guarantee, and no other value decodes. |
| `sovrium docs config design.density.floors.hit` | enum | Minimum interactive hit-target size in px. Fixed at 44 — declaring it restates the guarantee, and no other value decodes. |
| `sovrium docs config design.badgeForm` | enum | How every badge that shows a coloured option is drawn, on every surface: 'filled' paints the option colour as the fill (default); 'outline-dot' draws an outline and a leading dot in the option colour on a transparent chip. An option with no colour stays neutral either way. |
| `sovrium docs config design.baseline` | enum | Extend Sovrium's v1 default look ('extend', default) or replace it with a neutral floor ('replace'). |
| `sovrium docs config design.zones` | array | The app's zone map: which route patterns belong to which zone, and how each zone's voice departs from `design.voice`. |
| `sovrium docs config design.zones[]` | object | One route pattern, the zone it belongs to, and how its voice departs from the app default. |
| `sovrium docs config design.zones[].pattern` | string | The declared route pattern this zone governs (e.g. '/docs/*'), or the literal catch-all 'everything else'. |
| `sovrium docs config design.zones[].zone` | string | The zone this pattern belongs to (e.g. 'marketing', 'documentation', 'product'). |
| `sovrium docs config design.zones[].voice` | object | How this zone departs from `design.voice`. Per-FIELD: a declared field replaces the same field of `design.voice` for routes this zone governs; an undeclared field inherits. `personality` is not overridable — it is app identity, not situational register. |
| `sovrium docs config design.zones[].voice.pronoun` | string | How the system addresses the reader (e.g. 'tu', 'vous', 'you'). Free-form, because the register contract is per-language. |
| `sovrium docs config design.zones[].voice.prefer` | array | Copy patterns to reach for in this zone, replacing `design.voice.prefer` |
| `sovrium docs config design.zones[].voice.prefer[]` | string | One writing rule this zone reaches for |
| `sovrium docs config design.zones[].voice.avoid` | array | Copy patterns to refuse in this zone, replacing `design.voice.avoid` |
| `sovrium docs config design.zones[].voice.avoid[]` | string | One writing rule this zone refuses |
| `sovrium docs config design.zones[].voice.tone` | object | How the tone shifts per moment. The first four keys mirror the 'four moments where the system speaks'; `destructive` covers the confirmation that must name its consequence. |
| `sovrium docs config design.zones[].voice.tone.empty` | string | One writing rule, stated as an instruction a writer can obey |
| `sovrium docs config design.zones[].voice.tone.loading` | string | One writing rule, stated as an instruction a writer can obey |
| `sovrium docs config design.zones[].voice.tone.error` | string | One writing rule, stated as an instruction a writer can obey |
| `sovrium docs config design.zones[].voice.tone.success` | string | One writing rule, stated as an instruction a writer can obey |
| `sovrium docs config design.zones[].voice.tone.destructive` | string | One writing rule, stated as an instruction a writer can obey |
| `sovrium docs config design.logo` | object | The app's mark and the rules for placing it: the file, its dark-mode variant, its accessible name, clear space, minimum size, and what must never be done to it. |
| `sovrium docs config design.logo.src` | string | Root-relative path or `https://` URL of the primary mark |
| `sovrium docs config design.logo.srcDark` | string | Variant shown when the interface is in dark mode — i.e. the light-ink file. Omit when one mark reads on both surfaces. |
| `sovrium docs config design.logo.alt` | string | Accessible name of the mark — normally just the app's name |
| `sovrium docs config design.logo.clearSpace` | string | The exclusion zone around the mark, stated relative to the mark itself |
| `sovrium docs config design.logo.minWidth` | string | Smallest width the mark may be reproduced at |
| `sovrium docs config design.logo.misuse` | array | Things that must never be done to the mark |
| `sovrium docs config design.logo.misuse[]` | string | One thing that must never be done to the mark |
| `sovrium docs config design.imagery` | object | How the app looks where tokens cannot reach: the register images work in, the rules for photography, the one icon set, and the non-photographic marks. |
| `sovrium docs config design.imagery.principles` | array | What an image is FOR in this app, stated as convictions |
| `sovrium docs config design.imagery.principles[]` | string | One conviction about what an image is for here |
| `sovrium docs config design.imagery.photography` | array | What may be photographed, and how it must be treated |
| `sovrium docs config design.imagery.photography[]` | string | One rule about what may be photographed, and how |
| `sovrium docs config design.imagery.iconSet` | string | Name of the single icon set every icon in the app is drawn from |
| `sovrium docs config design.imagery.patterns` | array | Non-photographic visual marks: texture, illustration style, background geometry |
| `sovrium docs config design.imagery.patterns[]` | string | One rule about texture, illustration style or background geometry |
| `sovrium docs config design.principles` | array | The app's design convictions, ordered. Rendered at the top of the design-system export so an agent is handed the reasoning behind the tokens, not just the tokens. |
| `sovrium docs config design.principles[]` | string | One design conviction, stated as a single sentence |
| `sovrium docs config design.voice` | object | The app's voice: constant personality and address, the patterns it reaches for and refuses, and how its tone shifts per situation. |
| `sovrium docs config design.voice.personality` | array | Traits that hold across every surface, regardless of situation |
| `sovrium docs config design.voice.personality[]` | string | One writing rule, stated as an instruction a writer can obey |
| `sovrium docs config design.voice.pronoun` | string | How the system addresses the reader (e.g. 'tu', 'vous', 'you'). Free-form, because the register contract is per-language. |
| `sovrium docs config design.voice.prefer` | array | Copy patterns to reach for, stated as instructions |
| `sovrium docs config design.voice.prefer[]` | string | One writing rule, stated as an instruction a writer can obey |
| `sovrium docs config design.voice.avoid` | array | Copy patterns to refuse, stated as instructions |
| `sovrium docs config design.voice.avoid[]` | string | One writing rule, stated as an instruction a writer can obey |
| `sovrium docs config design.voice.tone` | object | How the tone shifts per moment. The first four keys mirror the 'four moments where the system speaks'; `destructive` covers the confirmation that must name its consequence. |
| `sovrium docs config design.voice.tone.empty` | string | One writing rule, stated as an instruction a writer can obey |
| `sovrium docs config design.voice.tone.loading` | string | One writing rule, stated as an instruction a writer can obey |
| `sovrium docs config design.voice.tone.error` | string | One writing rule, stated as an instruction a writer can obey |
| `sovrium docs config design.voice.tone.success` | string | One writing rule, stated as an instruction a writer can obey |
| `sovrium docs config design.voice.tone.destructive` | string | One writing rule, stated as an instruction a writer can obey |

## `design.components.button`

| Option | Kind | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sovrium docs config design.components.button` | object | Classes an operator adds to one engine component type: per part, per variant, per state, and whether to replace Sovrium's recipe or layer over it |
| `sovrium docs config design.components.button.parts` | object | Classes applied to each named part of the component |
| `sovrium docs config design.components.button.variants` | object | Per-part classes that apply only in the named variant |
| `sovrium docs config design.components.button.states` | object | Per-part classes that apply in one interaction state, written without the state prefix |
| `sovrium docs config design.components.button.states.hover` | object | Classes applied while the pointer is over the component. |
| `sovrium docs config design.components.button.states.focus` | object | Classes applied while the component holds keyboard focus, however it was reached. |
| `sovrium docs config design.components.button.states.focusVisible` | object | Classes applied while the component holds keyboard focus and the browser judges a focus ring warranted — typically after keyboard navigation, not after a click. |
| `sovrium docs config design.components.button.states.active` | object | Classes applied while the component is being pressed. |
| `sovrium docs config design.components.button.states.disabled` | object | Classes applied while the component refuses interaction. |
| `sovrium docs config design.components.button.states.open` | object | Classes applied while the component is expanded, such as an open menu or dialog trigger. |
| `sovrium docs config design.components.button.states.selected` | object | Classes applied while the component is the chosen one among its siblings. |
| `sovrium docs config design.components.button.states.checked` | object | Classes applied while a checkbox, radio or switch is on. |
| `sovrium docs config design.components.button.states.invalid` | object | Classes applied while the value the component holds has been refused. |
| `sovrium docs config design.components.button.states.current` | object | Classes applied to the entry that points at the page being read — the current link of a sidebar, a navigation menu or a breadcrumb. |
| `sovrium docs config design.components.button.replace` | boolean | Drop Sovrium's recipe for this type rather than layering on top of it. The accessibility floor still applies. |
